title: Zapatista uprising in Chiapas
summary: On 1 January 1994, the day the North American Free Trade Agreement took effect, the Zapatista Army of National Liberation (EZLN) took control of several municipalities in Chiapas, Mexico, including San Cristóbal de las Casas. The army retook them in a twelve-day campaign, and later talks produced the 1996 San Andrés Accords on indigenous rights.

uncertainty.note: Exact day given by all three sources.

as_recorded.value: The Zapatista rebellion began on January 1, 1994
